levels.name: stop writes
levels.action: engage the kill switch (global or per site)
levels.effect: writes and reads refuse with 503; the host page still renders

levels.name: dark the site
levels.action: set read_enabled and write_enabled to 0 for that site
levels.effect: the widget renders a notice; no data is changed

levels.name: revert the artifact
levels.action: repin the previous module_version and artifact_checksum
levels.effect: the previous widget is served; the API contract is unchanged

levels.name: roll back the schema
levels.effect: cp_* tables are dropped; no other product is touched
levels.warning: this discards comment data; the backup taken immediately before is the only recovery path, and the rehearsal proves that path works

data_recovery.backup_method: SQLite online backup API, not a filesystem copy of a live WAL file
data_recovery.verification: PRAGMA integrity_check and foreign_key_check on the copy

never: hard-deleting comment bodies as a rollback step
a rollback that also touches the ratings schema
